title: Affirmations for Anxiety Before Work
metaDescription: Short, permission-based affirmations for anxiety before a work day — from Ritula's Friction-band station.
intro: That knot in your stomach before you even open your laptop isn't a flaw — it's your body bracing for something before it's happened. These affirmations meet you there first, before asking you to feel any different.
corpusLines: You don't have to feel ready. You just have to begin.
This tightness is allowed to be here.
One task. Not the whole day.
howToUse: Read these before opening your laptop, or the moment you notice your shoulders tighten. Takes under a minute.
